llm.summary: This skill coherently stores useful PR review findings as project memory, with the main caution being that it can persist private review context when enabled.

dimensions.detail: The skill stores PR discussion details, participants, file references, tags, and related knowledge indexes, which is proportionate for institutional review memory but may include private project context.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected package contains markdown skill guidance and modules only; no executable install scripts, hidden commands, or package-time behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Automatic capture is disclosed as occurring after sanctum:pr-review Phase 6 and is constrained by finding severity and scoring, though retroactive capture is described more generally.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Persistent project-palace entries, backlinks, indexes, and optional embedding/search indexes are disclosed and purpose-aligned, with no evidence of unrelated privilege use or exfiltration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is to capture, organize, and retrieve PR-review knowledge in a project memory palace, and the artifact instructions consistently describe that workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only for projects where it is acceptable to retain PR review findings, participant names, file references, and architectural decisions in a searchable memory store. Teams handling sensitive repositories should define when retroactive capture is allowed and periodically prune outdated or confidential entries.
llm.findings: [SQP-1] expected: The trigger language is broad in places, especially retroactive capture, but the artifact ties automatic capture to PR-review completion and scoring thresholds; this supports a benign note rather than a Review verdict.
